name: Montevideo
tagline: South America's Safest Haven for Your FIRE Portfolio
description: Montevideo is the quiet achiever of Latin American FIRE destinations — politically stable, remarkably safe, and offering a quality of life that punches well above its weight. Uruguay's progressive policies, strong rule of law, and lack of foreign income taxation make it uniquely attractive for retirees seeking both lifestyle and financial security in South America.

quickFacts.visa: Rentista Visa (requires proof of stable passive income ~$1,500/mo; leads to permanent residency after 3-5 years)
quickFacts.safetyRating: Good — safest capital in South America; standard urban caution in Ciudad Vieja at night
quickFacts.climate: Humid subtropical — warm summers, mild winters, moderate rainfall year-round

housing.description: Furnished studio/small 1BR on the Pocitos edge or Ciudad Vieja, near the Rambla

dining.description: Mostly home cooking; a chivito or parrilla lunch out now and then

healthcare.description: Entry-level mutualista (private health cooperative), direct pay. Assumes an early retiree (45–55); older retirees should budget more.

transportation.description: STM monthly bus pass + occasional fare

1M.lifestyle: A furnished studio or small one-bedroom on the Pocitos edge or in Ciudad Vieja, within reach of the Rambla waterfront where morning walks with mate are a local ritual. Cooking at home is the norm, with an affordable chivito or parrilla lunch out now and then, and healthcare is an entry-level mutualista cooperative membership. The STM bus pass covers the city, and low-key entertainment — cinema, streaming, the beach — keeps costs down. Uruguay is genuinely more expensive than its neighbors, so even a frugal life here carries a higher floor, but it buys unusual safety and calm.

dining.description: Out a few times a week, casual + occasional mid-range

healthcare.description: Comprehensive mutualista (Médica Uruguaya / Hospital Británico entry)

2M.lifestyle: A solid furnished one-bedroom in mid-Pocitos, a safe and walkable neighborhood a short stroll from the sea. Dining out a few nights a week is easy, and a comprehensive mutualista plan (Médica Uruguaya or Hospital Británico) brings full private coverage. Transport is the bus pass plus regular taxi or Uber, and the budget stretches to a gym, cinema, and an unhurried social life. Uruguay's stability and low crime are the real draw, and they justify the higher costs.

housing.description: Prime furnished 1BR in Pocitos or Punta Carretas (ocean-facing)

healthcare.description: Top-tier mutualista with specialist + dental access

3M.lifestyle: A prime furnished one-bedroom in Pocitos or Punta Carretas, in the city's most desirable, ocean-facing districts. Dining out is frequent across casual and mid-range tables, and healthcare is a top-tier mutualista with specialist and dental access. Transport is the bus plus frequent taxi and Uber, and weekends reach Colonia del Sacramento or the ferry to Buenos Aires. Cultural events and regular social dining fill the calendar — a genuinely affluent life in the region's safest capital.

housing.description: Top-of-market 1BR/penthouse with ocean views in Punta Carretas or Carrasco

healthcare.description: Platinum mutualista (top scheme) + international coverage add-on

5M.lifestyle: A top-of-market one-bedroom or penthouse with ocean views in Punta Carretas or Carrasco, with a housekeeper a few days a week. Fine dining is regular, healthcare is a platinum mutualista plus an international coverage add-on, and transport is a private car or heavy private-hire. The discretionary budget funds clubs, theatre, and weekend trips to Punta del Este or José Ignacio. Uruguay's zero tax on foreign income is a meaningful advantage at this level.

healthcare.description: International concierge cover WITH medical evacuation (worldwide-excl-US platinum plan, priced for 45–55)

entertainment.description: Country/yacht clubs, art collecting, Punta del Este season

domesticHelp.description: Full-time housekeeper (~$880/mo incl. mandatory govt charges)

luxuryExtras.description: Club memberships, concierge, premium services, uncapped discretionary

10M.lifestyle: A best-address luxury house or penthouse in Carrasco, the city's most elegant district, run by a full-time housekeeper. Dining is near-daily at the finest tables, healthcare is an international concierge plan with worldwide coverage and evacuation, and a private car with driver handles transport. The uncapped discretionary budget runs to country and yacht clubs, art collecting, and the Punta del Este social season. Uruguay's stability, safety, and zero foreign-income tax make this the most secure base for top-tier living.
